title: No es freemium es de pago en más atado

title: Good but…
body:
I like the way the app works with the routines and trying to keep to it. But there are some points that could use some attention. Adding a routine, I would like to add some routines for the future, for when the kids go back to school, but once you add a routine, it puts in on your calendar right away you can choose an end date but no start date. Also if you put a routine on the wrong day you can’t edit it until it is that day! So I can’t edit a routine that’s on schedule for tomorrow, although it was meant for today. 
And I really hate I can’t change the calendar to start on Monday!
